json_ld_data.name: Tarot Candle Duo: The Lovers & Death
json_ld_data.description: Two Tarot candles. Two powerful readings. One transformative experience. The Love & Death Tarot Candle Duo brings together The Lovers and Death cards in a beautifully scented pairing designed to spark connection, reflection, and change. The Lovers represents attraction, passion, and meaningful choices, while Death symbolizes transformation, release, and new beginnings. Each candle combines original Tarot artwork, an illuminating reading, and a fragrance crafted to match the energy of the card. The Lovers features notes of Blood Orange, Wild Moss & Embers.Death features Tobacco Flower, Orange Peel & Leather. Light them together or separately depending on the energy you want to invite in.
